user.title: Samsung TV Remote – Connection Mode
user.description:
Choose how Home Assistant should talk to your Samsung TV.

• **Local** – direct WebSocket on your LAN (recommended, no cloud, no paid API)
• **Cloud** – via the existing SmartThings integration

cloud.title: SmartThings Integration
cloud.description: Select your SmartThings integration. Found {count} integration(s).

select_tv.title: Select Samsung TV
select_tv.description: Found {count} Samsung TV(s) in your SmartThings account.

local.title: Local TV Setup
local.description:
Enter the IP address of your Samsung TV.

On first connection the TV shows a permission popup – accept it.
The pairing token is stored automatically.

MAC address is optional and only needed for Wake-on-LAN (power on when fully off).

data.token: Pairing token (leave empty on first setup)
